Quick summary of what we need to create the vendor master in full:

2) Registered address (legal domicile) + any separate remit address

6) If you have a preferred payment term (net 30, net 45), and whether Redwood should set default term

I can create a preliminary record in our system today if you confirm the legal name and remit address below.
